# Fixed query sample for perf_bench.py -- DO NOT EDIT WITHOUT RE-MEASURING

# Chosen from the real encoder run 5dee7425dd46c5f154808aac (rank artifact), so every
# id below has a NON-NULL target rank in all three conditions. Selection rule, stated
# so the sample is reproducible rather than convenient:
#   - one query per FashionIQ category (dress/shirt/toptee), first by multimodal rank
#   - two queries whose multimodal rank is 9-11   (boundary at K=10)
#   - two queries whose multimodal rank is 49-51  (boundary at K=50)
#   - two of the last queries by index            (the final, partial batch)
# A query is only eligible if it also has a rank in the OTHER two conditions, because
# perf_bench runs all three and an unscored query would silently shrink the sample.
#
# format: <qid>\t<category>\t<rank_multimodal>\t<rank_image_only>\t<rank_text_only>\t<bucket>
